blocks.tamil_translation: fell asleep. Another person took his rope in jest. When the one who was sleeping woke up, he became alarmed at not finding his rope. The Prophet ﷺ said, “It is not permissible for any Muslim to alarm another Muslim.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: قَتْلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ اَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللهِ مِنْ زَوَالِ الدُّنْيَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي، باب تعظيم الدم، رقم:٣٩٩٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “The killing of a Mu'min is more terrible in the sight of Allah Ta'ala than the destruction of the entire world.” Hazrat Buraidah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Just as people regard the destruction of the world as terrible, the killing of a Mu'min is an even more terrible act than that in the sight of Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ سَعِيْدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ وَاَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵄ يَذْكُرَانِ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قاَلَ: لَوْ اَنَّ اَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ وَاَهْلَ اْلاَرْضِ اِشْتَرَكُوْا فِيْ دَمِ مُؤْمِنٍ لَأَكَبَّهُمُ اللهُ فِي النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث غريب، باب الحكم في الدماء، رقم:١٣٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Even if all those in the heavens and the earth joined together to kill one Mu'min, Allah Ta'ala would throw all of them face down into Jahannam.” Both Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri and Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrate that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: كُلُّ ذَنْبٍ عَسَي اللهُ اَنْ يَغْفِرَهُ اِلَّا مَنْ مَاتَ مُشْرِكًا، اَوْ مُؤْمِنٌ قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا
